Question 1
?

The equation 4z2+4z=12 can be written in the form (z+p)2=q. Find p+q, and solve the equation.

a
p+q=134,z=−1±132
b
p+q=114,z=3±112
c
p+q=154,z=−1±132
d
p+q=154,z=1±112
e
p+q=174,z=−3±112
Submit
